_about: T2 package vectors. Each entry is a frozen .treeship package under this directory and the verdict each verifier must give it. cli* columns are the `verdict` field of `treeship package verify --format json` (run.sh); receipt_only is the core-wasm verify_receipt outcome, which @treeship/verify's verifyReceipt returns (packages/core/tests/package_vectors.rs). xfail maps a column to the fix-plan task that makes it right; remove the entry in that task's PR. Every new advisory adds a vector.

honest/approval._note: under --strict on a second ship two rows fail: chain_completeness (approval statements carry no parent, so the approval is never chained) and replay-local-journal (a stranger has no Approval Use Journal, and --strict promotes that). Raised with the coordinator as a new finding; no fix-plan task yet

xfail.cli_strict: unassigned: approval unchained + strict needs a local journal
